company.name: Circuitway Analytics
company.one_line: B2B SaaS platform helping mid-market logistics companies forecast warehouse staffing needs.

market.description: Workforce forecasting software sold to mid-market logistics and 3PL operators managing seasonal staffing swings.

competitors.name: Palletform
competitors.positioning: Warehouse management suite with a bolt-on staffing module
competitors.relative_strength: Already embedded in customers' existing WMS, higher switching cost to displace

competitors.name: Shiftwise
competitors.positioning: Point solution for hourly workforce scheduling across industries
competitors.relative_strength: Cheaper entry price, wins price-sensitive SMB deals

competitors.name: Northtrail Ops
competitors.relative_strength: Deeper forecasting models, but a six-month implementation cycle

situation.prompt: Circuitway's forecasting module is accurate for customers with a single warehouse, but activation drops sharply for customers running more than three sites: only 34.7% of multi-site customers reach their first accurate forecast within 30 days, versus 81.2% of single-site customers. What do you do about the multi-site segment, which is 46% of the pipeline this quarter?
situation.tension: Multi-site customers are the larger pipeline opportunity, but fixing multi-site forecasting accuracy could mean rebuilding the model architecture rather than a targeted product fix, with no guarantee it resolves activation.
options: Rebuild the forecasting engine to natively model multi-site inventory transfer
Ship a manual override tool that lets multi-site customers correct forecasts site by site
De-prioritize multi-site customers this quarter and focus onboarding investment on single-site accounts
constraints: Engineering has 2 backend engineers available for the next two quarters
Sales has already booked $1.2M in multi-site pipeline assuming the feature ships
Cannot slip the Q3 board commitment to grow logo count 25% without a new segment strategy
situation.leadership_belief: The CEO believes multi-site accuracy is an onboarding and training problem, not a modeling problem, because the few multi-site customers who succeeded had unusually hands-on onboarding.

supporting_facts: Multi-site customers reach their first accurate forecast within 30 days only 34.7% of the time, versus 81.2% for single-site customers.
Multi-site opportunities are 46% of this quarter's sales pipeline by dollar value.
Circuitway has 94 paying customers and $6.1M in ARR.
Palletform is bundled into the WMS software already used by roughly a third of Circuitway's target accounts.
Shiftwise undercuts Circuitway's list price by roughly 30% on comparable deal sizes.
Northtrail Ops requires a six-month implementation, which has cost it deals against Circuitway in competitive bids.
Engineering has 2 backend engineers available who are not already committed to other roadmap items.
Sales has booked $1.2M in pipeline this quarter that assumes multi-site forecasting improves.
The three multi-site customers who succeeded received more than 10 hours of hands-on onboarding each, versus an average of 2 hours company-wide.
Monthly churn is 2.4%, concentrated among multi-site accounts that never reached an accurate forecast.
